items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: What's the little Pete Herman, the one that went blind? Yeah.

ctx.x: He put his money in good juice up there. Yeah, they had... Then they had Harry Wills, the human scissors, boxcar shorty, rough house wares. Joe Mandot used to fight Johnny Dundee. Yeah, we saw a Mandot fight over here. Frankie Russell, Joe Thomas.
What's the little Pete Herman, the one that went blind? Yeah. They always have a lot of fights.
Did you play inside at the fights too?
